top_signals.title: Russia Ukraine War Becomes Economic Battle
top_signals.summary: New York Times Kyiv bureau chief Andrew Kramer tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Russia and Ukraine are increasingly targeting each other’s economies as the war shifts toward attacks on energy, transportation and export infrastructure. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Kramer says Ukraine is using its expanding drone arsenal to target Russia’s oil industry and its ability to finance a prolonged war. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: McDonald’s Sell-Off Hits 30% as Big Mac Inflation Spurs Pushback
top_signals.summary: McDonald’s Corp. faces a key challenge as it fights to reinvigorate a sagging stock price: Winning back the cost-conscious diners who believe its menu has become too expensive.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
